images.caption: Figure 2:Comparison of different Painting Change Map modalities.First row:Ground truth painting process (source video from the “Painting with Samir” YouTube channel[25]).Second row:Interpolation-based variant, where earlier painting actions map closer to white and later actions map closer to black.Third row:Pack 24-bit variant, which assigns a distinct color to each individual painting step.Fourth row:History mode, featuring independent interpolation across all three RGB channels.Fifth row:A hybrid approach, fusing the interpolation mechanism (in the R channel) with outlines extracted via a lineart processor (in the GB channels).
(a)Reconstruction of the painting process using oracle change maps (computed from ground truth video). Source video from the “A Lu Art” YouTube channel[2].
